source.author: Aerenax
source.title: [25.24] Echoes from the deep! - A comprehensive Nautilus guide.

fields: A skill matchup. Play around the cooldown of his W-Q combo, and watch out for Flash combos from good Alistars.
He stays right on top of you, which makes hooks awkward to land. Dodge his Q and then re-engage onto his carry.
Ashe is very squishy and your base damage is high, so almost any hook that lands on her should turn into a kill.
He roams a lot and you will struggle to follow him. If you stay in lane, make the enemy ADC's life as hard as possible while he is gone.
One of your easiest lanes. If he grabs your ADC, follow up with your own hook; if he grabs you, he has just brought you into range to lock him or his ADC down.
He chips you down with constant poke, but if you catch him you can burst him. Stay patient and do not let your health drop too low before you find a hook.
A failed engage gives him lots of ways to lock you down, and his shield absorbs a lot of your damage. Play around his E cooldown and you should win.
He controls the brushes and will fear you as soon as you go in, so tenacity is a strong pick. Once out of the fear you can cut his healing or interrupt his ultimate. Prioritize vision.
She pokes with W and has timely disengage with Q or her ultimate. Patience is key; wait for those spells to be used before committing.
She brings strong damage and utility. Avoid her empowered Q, and remember her shields mean she will not die instantly to your combo, so choose fights carefully.
Her E lands her behind you, so you cannot use your hook to escape. Re-engaging is hard as well, so make sure you are the one who starts fights.
She will polymorph you and ult her carry, denying your burst. Bait those spells out before re-engaging.
Her E is hard to dodge, but any hook on her should kill. Sidestep her Q and burst her.
He reaches you easily and has long CC with W and Q, but he lacks escape tools, so punish him when he commits.
His Q can knock you away and cancel your hook pull, and his ultimate cleanses CC on his whole team. It cannot remove the knock-up from your ultimate, so lean on that.
Your worst matchup: her root lasts long, her shield blocks your engages, and she hits hard. The author bans her every game.
Her slow, bubble stun and wave disengage make engaging hard. Play around her ultimate, which is ideal for stopping your engage.
He deals heavy damage. Play around his W leap, interrupting it mid-air or as soon as he lands on your carry.
She disengages easily with W or her ultimate, and an aggressive Poppy uses W to stop you escaping with your hook.
Squishy but mobile. Catch him and burst him quickly; if you fail to finish him he regenerates, but you can try again.
Easy once you know it: hook him as he starts his ultimate engage. Getting charmed is fine if he is stopped too, and shutting down his engage wins fights.
Her W has a slow wind-up that your hook can cancel. If she misses it, punish hard; doing this consistently wins the lane.
Plays like a Lux: dodge her Q and E. Her W makes 2v2s much harder, and her ultimate can make your passive root your own allies.
She outranges you heavily, deals lots of damage, and her W root is strong CC in lane. Expect a hard lane.
She pokes from long range and sustains with W. If she misses her empowered E root or her ultimate, all-in her, but make sure you can kill her or her sustain will undo your damage.
His boxes block your hooks in lane, but he offers little in teamfights. Play around his stealth and punish him away from his boxes.
Annoying poke but no CC besides her ultimate. Play around her cooldowns, respect the ultimate, and you should win most lanes.
One of the easiest matchups. Dodge her Q and she offers little; her E silence is the only thing that can stop your engage.
He pulls you in with E or any lane CC and then bursts you, while you struggle to burst him back. Avoid his pull range.
He walks up to stack his passive on you, and from level 6 he can protect his carry with his kit. Expect a tough lane.
He sustains well and fights back on all-ins. Dodge his E stun, and back off when he ultimates, re-engaging after it expires.
Looks easy, but his E can cancel your hook follow-up and leave you open to his own hook. Respect the flay.
His poke will likely push you under tower at half health. Learn his Q angles, play around his E, and hook him when his spells are down.
His passive refunds mana so he can keep poking. Dodge his spells and engage when he steps too far forward.
She has little lane pressure, so pressure the enemy ADC hard; her healing cannot outpace your burst. Kill her when she detaches.
His bombs can stun you through minions, and his E slow is annoying. Stay away from your own minions and wait for him to overstep.
Her plants block your hook. Play around her E and punish misplaced plants or a missed E.
